nodes.name: Git Pull via MCP
nodes.notes: Calls the local MCP server in this repo. Replace /home/bograh/Code/cloud-storage-with-s3 with your actual repo directory.

nodes.name: Read Codebase via MCP
nodes.notes: Searches source files using the MCP search_files tool. Replace /home/bograh/Code/cloud-storage-with-s3.

parameters.name: params
parameters.value: ={{ { name: 'run_command', arguments: { command: 'git log --since=yesterday --oneline && printf "\n---TODOS---\n" && (grep -rn "TODO\\|FIXME\\|HACK\\|XXX\\|BUG" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" --include="*.py" --include="*.go" . | head -50 || true)', cwd: '/home/bograh/Code/cloud-storage-with-s3', timeout_ms: 30000 } } }}

nodes.name: Inspect Code Markers via MCP
nodes.notes: Grabs recent git log + TODO/FIXME markers from the codebase.

parameters.name: system
parameters.value: You are a senior software engineer acting as a daily task planner. Analyze the provided codebase structure, recent git activity, and code markers (TODOs, FIXMEs, etc.) and generate a realistic, prioritized list of development tasks for today. Return your response as a valid JSON object only — no markdown, no preamble. Schema: { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "summary": "one sentence project status", "tasks": [ { "id": "T001", "priority": "high|medium|low", "category": "bugfix|feature|refactor|test|docs|chore", "title": "short task title", "description": "2-3 sentence description", "file_hints": ["path/to/relevant/file"], "estimated_minutes": 30 } ] }

parameters.name: messages

nodes.name: Generate Tasks (Claude AI)
nodes.notes: Uses Claude to analyze the codebase and produce structured task list. Add your Anthropic API key in credentials.

nodes.name: Save Tasks to Disk via MCP
nodes.notes: Saves the generated task list to /home/bograh/Code/cloud-storage-with-s3/.n8n-tasks/ as a JSON file for evening retrieval.

nodes.name: Send Morning Tasks to Slack
nodes.notes: Configure your Slack credential and target channel.

nodes.name: Send Morning Tasks Email
nodes.notes: Configure your SMTP credential. Update fromEmail and toEmail.

nodes.name: Load Morning Tasks via MCP
nodes.notes: Evening: loads the task file saved this morning.

parameters.name: params
parameters.value: ={{ { name: 'run_command', arguments: { command: 'git log --since="today 00:00" --stat --oneline', cwd: '/home/bograh/Code/cloud-storage-with-s3', timeout_ms: 30000 } } }}

nodes.name: Get Today Git Activity via MCP
nodes.notes: Evening: gets today's commits plus per-commit file stats.

parameters.name: params
parameters.value: ={{ { name: 'run_command', arguments: { command: 'printf "remaining todos: " && (grep -rn "TODO\\|FIXME\\|HACK" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" --include="*.py" --include="*.go" . | wc -l || true) && printf "\n" && (grep -rn "TODO\\|FIXME" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" --include="*.py" --include="*.go" . | head -20 || true)', cwd: '/home/bograh/Code/cloud-storage-with-s3', timeout_ms: 30000 } } }}

nodes.name: Count Remaining TODOs via MCP
nodes.notes: Evening: counts remaining TODOs to measure progress.

parameters.name: system
parameters.value: You are a senior engineering manager writing an end-of-day development report. Compare the morning task list against today's git activity and code state. Return a valid JSON object only — no markdown, no preamble. Schema: { "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "overall_completion": 0-100, "productivity_score": "A|B|C|D", "executive_summary": "2-3 sentences", "tasks": [ { "id": "T001", "title": "...", "status": "completed|partial|not_started", "evidence": "what git activity or code change supports this status", "completion_pct": 0-100 } ], "unplanned_work": [ { "description": "...", "impact": "positive|neutral|negative" } ], "blockers": [ "..." ], "tomorrow_suggestions": [ "..." ], "metrics": { "commits_today": 0, "files_changed": 0, "todos_resolved": 0 } }
